key_takeaway: Key takeaway: Genetic studies still draw most of their participants from European-ancestry populations (roughly 80 to 96 percent depending on the source and year), and the groups least represented are the ones for whom risk scores and variant interpretation have been shown to work less well. The sources disagree on whether the gap is closing because they count participants differently, so no single trend can be trusted, but very low African, Hispanic or Latin American, and indigenous representation is consistent across every source.
